catalog_unavailable: Card data is not ready yet, try again in a moment.
too_fast: Wait a moment before trying again.
pack_missing: You are not holding that pack.
pack_unknown: This item is not set as the pack of any collection.
player_unavailable: Your player data is not loaded yet.
insert_failed: The card could not be written to the database.
pack_cooldown: Wait a moment before opening another pack.
pack_refused: Packs of this division cannot be opened right now.
pack_empty: This division has no cards yet.
box_cooldown: Wait a moment before opening another box.
card_in_use: Card is still owned by a player. Delete it anyway is not possible yet.
division_item_taken: That item is already used by another division.
division_in_use: Division still has cards. Move or delete them first.
pack_full: Your inventory is full, the pack cannot be opened.
pack_held: Your inventory is full, cards from your last pack are on hold. Free some space and open a pack again.
pack_owed: %s cards from an unfinished pack were added to your inventory.
box_missing: You are not holding that box.
box_unknown: This item is not set as the box of any collection.
box_refused: Boxes of this division cannot be opened right now.
box_full: Your inventory is full, the box cannot be opened.
box_opened: Box opened, %s packs went into your inventory.
sleeve_graded: A graded card is sealed for good.
sleeve_full: Your inventory is full, the sleeve cannot be returned.
sleeve_done: Card sleeved. Its condition will not drop any more.
album_closed: You are no longer holding that album.
album_unknown: This album belongs to no division.
album_graded: A graded card cannot go into an album.
album_pocket_taken: That card is already in the album.
album_full: Your inventory is full, the card cannot be taken out.
album_missing: You are not carrying a %s album.
album_wrong: This card only fits a %s album.
album_choose: You carry more than one album. Drag the card onto the album you want.
grading_no_card: You have no card to grade.
grading_full: Your inventory is full, the sleeve cannot be returned.

ui.pack_tear: Drag the top to the left to tear it open
ui.give_confirm_body: {name} goes to the closest player and leaves your inventory.
ui.grading_all_done: You have no card left to grade.
ui.grading_final: Once sealed the card stops wearing and keeps its mark. This cannot be undone.
ui.grading_sleeve_kept: The sleeve comes off for sealing and is handed back to you.
ui.grading_sleeve_lost: The sleeve is cut open for sealing and is lost.
ui.editor_no_division: No collection yet. Create one, then fill its slots with cards.
ui.editor_division_delete_body: {name} will be deleted for good, along with its empty binders. This cannot be undone.
ui.editor_code_hint: The three-letter code is printed before every card number. Slots is how many cards the collection holds.
ui.editor_item_hint: Every item must already exist in ox_inventory. Box and binder items are optional.
ui.editor_image_hint: An https:// link or a file shipped as img/name.png in web/public. Leave it empty and the card draws a picture of its own.
ui.editor_weight_share: Chance among cards of this class:
ui.editor_weight_hint: A relative weight, not a percentage. A card at 30 comes out three times more often than one at 10. The rarity itself is drawn by the Booster tab.
ui.editor_card_delete_body: The card is deleted along with every album copy. Copies in player inventories stay but will no longer open.
ui.editor_discard_body: Your changes to this card will be lost.
ui.editor_error_forbidden: You are not allowed to edit cards.
ui.editor_error_too_fast: Wait a moment before trying again.
ui.editor_error_name: The name must be 1 to 64 characters.
ui.editor_error_code: The code must be exactly three letters.
ui.editor_error_code_taken: Another collection already uses that code.
ui.editor_error_shrink: Cards still sit past that slot. Move them first.
ui.editor_error_pack_item: The pack item is invalid or not registered in ox_inventory.
ui.editor_error_box_item: The box item is invalid or not registered in ox_inventory.
ui.editor_error_album_item: The album item is invalid or not registered in ox_inventory.
ui.editor_error_item_taken: One of the items is used by another collection, or twice.
ui.editor_error_back_color: The colour must be a hex code like #0c8599.
ui.editor_error_cover: The cover must be an https:// link or img/name.png.
ui.editor_error_not_empty: The collection still holds cards. Retire it instead.
ui.editor_error_number: The slot number is outside the collection.
ui.editor_error_occupied: Another card already sits in that slot.
ui.editor_error_class: That rarity is not in the config.
ui.editor_error_image: Artwork must be an https:// link or img/name.png.
ui.editor_error_framing: Zoom goes from 1 to 3, offsets from -50 to 50.
ui.editor_cover_hint: Shown on the pack while it is opened. An https:// link or img/name.png in web/public. Empty keeps the default pack design.
ui.editor_class_hint: Which pack slot can produce this card and how loud its reveal is. It changes nothing about how it looks.
ui.editor_preview_hint: Exactly what players will see. Move the pointer over it.
ui.editor_give_hint: It lands in your inventory in the state you pick.
ui.editor_discard_hint: This card has changes that were never saved.
ui.grading_drop: Drag a card here or click one on the left
ui.editor_foil_hint: Chosen per card, free of its rarity. Hover the preview to see it move.
ui.editor_color_hint: Frame, stat and glow colour. The rarity colour is used when none is picked.
ui.editor_texts_hint: Leave a field empty and the card simply does not print that line.
ui.editor_defaults_shared: These are the default settings, shared by every collection. Saving gives this one its own copy.
ui.editor_defaults_own: This collection uses its own settings.
ui.editor_booster_chance_hint: At least one card of that rarity per pack.
ui.editor_quality_hint: A band whose start and end are equal always gives that exact state. That is how a 100 is made rare.
ui.editor_quality_grades_hint: The mark a card carries when it leaves a booster, before any wear.
ui.editor_error_template: That template is not in the config.
ui.editor_error_effect: That foil is not available on this template.
ui.editor_error_color: Colour must be a hex code like #3b82f6.
ui.editor_error_hp: Hit points are 8 characters at most.
ui.editor_error_booster_class: One of the rarities is unknown.
ui.editor_error_booster_total: The weights of every slot must total 100.
ui.editor_error_quality_range: Bands stay within 0 and 100, and start no higher than they end.
